create_aimv2_vision_config: create an Aimv2VisionConfig instance with custom hidden_size, image_size, and patch_size for the vision encoder
create_aimv2_text_config: create an Aimv2TextConfig instance with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and vocab_size for the text encoder
create_aimv2_config: create an Aimv2Config instance combining text_config and vision_config for the multimodal AIMv2 model
create_aimv2_config_from_dicts: create an Aimv2Config instance by passing text_config and vision_config as dictionaries
build_aimv2_model_from_config: build an Aimv2Model from an Aimv2Config instance for multimodal image-text encoding
